payload.core_mechanism_summary: For overlapping intervals, subtract initial intersection. If not overlapping, try using i segments: pay margin per segment to connect, then extend to meet k, taking min steps over i.
payload.rationale: The algorithm enumerates number of segments to 'connect', paying fixed cost to bring intervals into overlap, then extends, choosing the minimal total steps. This has a greedy exchange proof: optimal to use contiguous strategy per segment count.
